verified_key_information_units.information: Eleving Group achieved all-time best financial performance in 2024 with EUR 29.6 mln net profit (21% YoY increase), EUR 216.6 mln revenue (+15% YoY), EUR 89.8 mln EBITDA (+10% YoY), and EUR 371.2 mln net loan portfolio (+16% YoY).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report '2024 at a glance'; Consolidated statements of profit and loss; CEO keynote

candidate_sentences.text: Eleving Group delivered record financial performance in 2024, supported by strong portfolio growth, higher demand and improved operational efficiency.
Revenue increased nearly 15% to EUR 216.6 million from EUR 189.3 million in 2023, while adjusted EBITDA rose more than 16% to EUR 89.8 million from EUR 77.5 million.
Total net profit reached an all-time high of EUR 29.6 million, up almost 21% from EUR 24.5 million.
Loan issuance increased 26.8% to EUR 368.6 million, and the net loan and pre-owned vehicle rental portfolio grew 16% to EUR 371.2 million from EUR 320.3 million.

verified_key_information_units.information: Key year-over-year improvements included a 29.3% capitalization ratio (vs 26.1% in 2023), 2.4 interest coverage ratio (vs 2.3), and reduced net leverage to 3.3x (from 3.7x).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report financial highlights; Note 48 Alternative Performance Measures

candidate_sentences.text: Total equity increased to EUR 108.1 million from EUR 65.4 million, the capitalization ratio improved to 29.3% from 26.1%, and net leverage declined to 3.3 from 3.7.

verified_key_information_units.information: Major performance drivers were organic growth in Europe/Africa, successful integration of Sub-Saharan operations (tripling regional portfolio), digital transformation (doubled applications, new self-service platform), and enhanced risk management improving portfolio quality.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO keynote; Management report operations section

candidate_sentences.text: Demand was supported by digitalization, expanded sales channels and the completion of the Sub-Saharan integration; the combined portfolio in the Group’s three main Sub-Saharan markets tripled during the year.
Applications nearly doubled, while vehicle-finance applications increased 80.9%.
Sustainability and product development also advanced, including financing more than 2,000 electric motorcycles in East Africa.

verified_key_information_units.information: Business segments showed vehicle finance (67% of portfolio: 45% traditional, 20% flexible/subscription) and consumer finance (33%: Kredo, Tigo, etc.), with key growth in East Africa (e-motorcycles), Romania, Uganda, and Albania offsetting exits from Balkan/Belarus.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report segments; Sustainability statement portfolio balance; Note 19 discontinued operations

verified_key_information_units.information: Capital structure transformed via October 2024 IPO raising EUR 29.0 mln equity (largest in Nasdaq Riga history), used to repay subordinated bonds and high-cost Mintos loans, while expanding local currency funding (Kenya +30%, Botswana notes).

candidate_sentences.text: The Group strengthened its capital position through its October IPO, raising EUR 29.0 million and listing shares on Nasdaq Riga and the Frankfurt Stock Exchange.
Total equity increased to EUR 108.1 million from EUR 65.4 million, the capitalization ratio improved to 29.3% from 26.1%, and net leverage declined to 3.3 from 3.7.
IPO proceeds enabled early repayment of subordinated bonds and selected higher-cost borrowings.

verified_key_information_units.information: Strategic priorities include deepening existing markets, broadening product portfolio (e.g., electric motorcycle financing surpassing 2025 targets), geographic expansion, and developing ESG strategy for 2026-2031 with climate neutrality targets for HQ operations.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Business outlook; Sustainability framework; CEO keynote

candidate_sentences.text: Sustainability and product development also advanced, including financing more than 2,000 electric motorcycles in East Africa.

The Group’s overall performance strengthened during the year, and management plans continued portfolio expansion, new products and markets, further funding diversification and a 50% dividend payout ratio in 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: Post-reporting period events include March 2025 senior secured bond tap (EUR 40 mln at reduced yield) and expected North Macedonia tax refund of EUR 1.151 mln from 2023 solidarity tax, both impacting 2025 liquidity.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 47 Events after balance sheet date

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, and K5 are fully present with supporting sentences covering all core elements. K6 is partially present as it mentions electric motorcycle financing and product/market expansion but omits specific ESG strategy timeline and climate neutrality targets. K4 is missing entirely - no breakdown of vehicle vs consumer finance segments or geographic growth offsets are present. K7 is missing as there is no mention of post-reporting period events (March 2025 bond tap or tax refund). The summary captures most high-importance financial and strategic elements but lacks two full criteria and one partial, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of strong financial performance in 2024. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational problems. The summary flows logically from revenue and profit growth to specific line items, portfolio quality improvements, capital structure changes, and future plans. While there is some numerical detail, all relationships (e.g., revenue growth, EBITDA growth, net profit adjustments) are presented consistently without contradictions. The structure moves from overall performance to specific metrics, then to capital structure and future plans, creating a coherent whole. There is no unnecessary repetition that reduces clarity.
